content.text:
It’s meant to help you **notice connections between the passage you’re reading and another passage later in your draft**.

“Further on in this piece” means Twyne found a later passage that might:

- repeat the same point;
- contradict or complicate this one;
- pay off something introduced here;
- return to the same image or theme.

The card quotes that passage, explains the possible relationship, and lets you jump to it. The intended value is spotting structural connections without scrolling around.

The weakness is that it can fall back to matching shared words without confirming meaning. In that case, it can feel like it’s merely showing you your own writing again. My assessment: it earns its space when it makes a useful connection explicit; a later excerpt alone isn’t enough.

The matching logic is in [flow-conductor.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/components/editor/extensions/flow-conductor.ts:926).
